outcome: The public site and parcel path return the Angular application shell (HTTP 200). Its linked production bundle configures parcel/locality APIs and exposes the routes above, but every bounded API GET tested from the primary network returns HTTP 502 in under 0.9 seconds. No API payload or geometry was returned; do not infer that parcel geometry is absent. The one secondary-network check failed TLS validation before HTTP. This is a concrete upstream/API availability blocker, not a sandbox DNS failure.
